title: Add support for an OAuth 1.0 authorization scheme

raw.title: Add support for an OAuth 1.0 authorization scheme
raw.body: Currently, the Swagger 1.2 specification supports three authorization schemes: basic authentication, API key and OAuth2.  One popular scheme that is missing is [OAuth 1.0](http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849); can it be added to the next specification version?
